title: Interplay of Nonstabilizerness and Ergotropy in Quantum Batteries
summary: Nonstabilizerness plays an essential role in the efficient simulation of quantum systems on quantum computers. In this work, we investigate its role in the context of quantum batteries (QBs). To this end, we consider a system of N spin-1/2 particles, with the left half serving as the charger and the right half as the battery. By studying different classes of interactions between the charger and the battery, we quantify the amount of nonstabilizerness required to store work in the QB.
